title: Z9.F — Selected actual rational function has absolute sum b+a ζ(9)
milestone_description: For even n≥2 and integers b,a, the genuine weighted rational function belonging to the selected rational quartic is absolutely summable on positive natural arguments and has sum b+a times the real part of riemannZeta at 9. The target preserves the exact chosen multiplier and output order; it does not claim nonvanishing or integer polynomial coefficients.
